name: B10-0291/2026 (ECR) – Political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the European Union to suspend its cooperation agreement with Cuba and to start ending it. It asks for sanctions on Cuba's leaders, including Miguel Díaz-Canel, and for European money to stop going to Cuban state bodies. It wants all political prisoners freed and support for Cuba's united opposition. The text is the Parliament's position and a set of demands; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands suspension of the EU-Cuba agreement and EU sanctions on Cuban leaders.
- **Who it affects:** Cuba's government and its security forces, European companies trading with Cuban state firms, and EU funding.
- **What happens next:** The Council and EU countries must decide whether to act on these demands.
